answers.text: Blocking criteria are listed for the trustees
answers.evidence: Both graders agree (pass / pass). A: The reply opens with "The flow didn't reach any level yet" and then lists in plain words every G2 criterion that failed and blocks L1. These include both examples in the test: "Paste blocked: you can't paste into the password field" (3.3.8, A11Y-14/F-0012) and "No focus highlight: the sign-up form shows no highlight on the field you're in" (2.4.7, A11Y-04/F-0011). The other three are "Faint text ... 2.5:1 against a required 4.5:1" (1.4.3, A11Y-01 F-0003 + A11Y-11 F-0005), "Faint field borders ... 1.4:1 against a required 3:1" (1.4.11, A11Y-12/F-0004) and "Small buttons ... 20 px; the minimum is 24 px" (2.5.8, A11Y-01/F-0002). Together these are exactly the five SCs the report's WCAG table marks fail (1.4.3, 1.4.11, 2.4.7, 2.5.8, 3.3.8). Some G2 criteria block L1 because their checks did not run rather than because they failed (A11Y-06, -10, -13, -15, -16, -18). The report's section 7 describes each of them in words, for example "Modal dialogs ... not_run" and "Forms: visible persistent label ... not_run". Of these the reply names only dialogs, and adds "31 are still unchecked". Minor gap: the reply never says "L1" or "blocking". It makes the link by putting the list straight after "didn't reach any level yet". B: The reply describes in plain words every G2 criterion that has findings and blocks L1. These match the five SCs marked fail in the report's WCAG table (1.4.3, 1.4.11, 2.4.7, 2.5.8, 3.3.8), and both examples are covered: 'Paste blocked: you can't paste into the password field' (3.3.8, A11Y-14, F-0012) and 'No focus highlight: the sign-up form shows no highlight on the field you're in' (2.4.7, A11Y-04, F-0011). It also covers faint text ('2.5:1 against a required 4.5:1', A11Y-01/A11Y-11), faint field borders ('1.4:1 against a required 3:1', A11Y-12) and small buttons ('20 px; the minimum is 24 px', A11Y-01). It presents these as the reason 'The flow didn't reach any level yet', in content meant for the trustees ('Strengths to mention honestly'). The report's verdict also names A11Y-01 and A11Y-04 under 'Blocking L1'. Caveat: the reply does not name every G2 blocker that is blocking only because its check did not run (targets, forms, live-regions, lang, cross-page). Among the checks that did not run, it names only 'dialogs', plus '31 are still unchecked'. The how's examples are both failing criteria, so this gap does not change the verdict.
